name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 9 · essuyer, redresser, masser
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (scarecrow straightening his hat, girl wiping the sticky sweet spill, hiker pulling off his boots at his lodging on the balcony, dad's dancing embarrassing his son at the upper window, octopus massaging the postman on the roof terrace), -ir RIGHT (the splash flattening Annie's tiered sandcastle). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles. Regraded neutral (neutralize.py).
